{{Top|leg}}
'''Clan Balya''', along with [[clan Alya]] and [[clan Ilya]], was one of three [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[clan]]s originally chosen to settle the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].

Balya was the largest of the three, and was chosen for the colonization owing to its close connections to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] government, considerably aiding the datawork pertaining to the planet's change of ownership and general development and commerce.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Being one of the founding clans, Balya members could occupy positions in the [[Bothan Colonial Board]] of Kothlis, and one additional member represented the clan.<ref name="guide" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], Balya maintained with the [[Galactic Empire]] the ties they had with the Republic; thanks to that, the Empire kept a light presence on the colony.<ref name="guide" />
